SHAH AND ARUN KUMAR, JJ. ) B Criminal Procedure Code, 1973-Section 125-Maintenance-Liability­ Husband pleading concealment of pregnancy of wife at the time of marriage thus marriage invalid and husband not liable to pay maintenance-However, C husband attended wife thus husband cannot raise such plea-Also the husband's behaviour after the marriage not supporting his plea-Hence marriage valid and husband liable to pay maintenance.
